  aria-label attribute cannot be used on a time with no valid role attribute.

button[aria-label="saved v0"] :: Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size (59.5px by 17.4px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diamet

button[aria-label="Close Files"] :: Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size because it is partially obscured (smallest space is 24px by 17px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its close
